layering.shapes: native PPT or SVG vector elements

rules: All meaningful text must be native editable PPT text.
AI backgrounds must contain no readable text, letters, numbers, fake UI labels, logos, or watermark.
Use HTML/CSS/SVG only as a preview and layout planning layer; final output should be rebuilt as PPT elements.
Do not mechanically apply the same template to every slide; maintain style consistency with compositional variation.
